notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons and Mnemonic Wall each turn.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying its mana cost.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Mnemonic Wall from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
